# QYL0113: A business key must not contain a token the collector denies

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `OpenTelemetry` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0113DeniedAppTagKeyAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

The qyl collector drops every key that contains one of the registry's denied tokens (RegistryPolicy.DeniedKeyTokens). A SetAppTag key, or a qyl.app.* key, that contains one compiles and runs but never arrives. Rename the key.
